unity-verifier.description: Runs the project's Unity harness (rules, recompile, EditMode tests, Play mode smoke) against the open Editor and reports results. Strictly read-only — never edits code; any file change is detected by the workflow guard and voids the run. Use after an implementation step to get an independent pass/fail verdict.

unity-reviewer.description: Reviews the current C# diff against this project's Unity coding rules (SRP, file length, encapsulation with SerializeField, comment and Debug.Log rules when enabled, no LINQ/string concat/GetComponent in Update, CompareTag) and for correctness bugs. Read-only. Use after implementation, in parallel with unity-verifier.

plan-loader.description: Reads an approved plan.md and returns its key facts (summary, complexity, test assemblies, smoke expectations) as structured data. Read-only, has no shell and no write tools. Used by the unity-feature workflow when args.planFile is given.

run-log-writer.description: Writes the judgment parts of a harness run report (title, summary, plan notes, per-file descriptions, noise suggestions) as notes; the unity-harness CLI renders report.md from them plus changes.json and the run facts. Also fixes the notes when an audit lists discrepancies. Only writes inside the given run directory.

run-log-auditor.description: Independently audits the judged parts of a harness run report.md (file descriptions, summary, plan notes, noise suggestions) against changes.diff and facts.json, then writes audit.md. Never edits report.md or project files.
